LESSON: LEADERSHIP IN ISRAEL

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Bible 3.2 Divisions of the Bible (6 lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, 
Topic 3.4: Leadership in Israel

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Leadership in Israel
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why was leadership in Israel important?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe how God prepared Moses for leadership in Israel 
2. identify the roles played by Moses during the Exodus
3. apply leadership qualities learnt from Moses in their daily lives
4. value responsibility by choosing credible leaders
